notes.title: Cyber-Doge 2077 Announcement
notes.content:
Hello friends!
We have a new game coming out soon - Cyber-Doge 2077: Meme runner.
[previewyoutube=wyzZi_0rXMk;full][/previewyoutube]
About the game
Furious 3D runner about a pumped up dog. Run as far as possible! Collect coins! Set new records and enjoy a great soundtrack.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1383720/Cyberdoge_2077_Meme_runner/

If you like the game, please add it to your Steam Wishlist.

Best regards,
Take Toad.

notes.title: MacOS and Linux and 25% discount
notes.content:
Major changes

 Support introduced MacOS.
 Support introduced Linux.
 Fixed controller errors. Now the game fully supports wireless controllers.
 A bit of optimization.

25% discount

notes.title: Gamepad support and balancing fixes
notes.content:
Added support for the controller
 Tutorial fixed.
 lvl3. Added checkpoint near boss of the gym.
 Superflex healing now.
 Sexual splash. 65 flexpoints needed now. (50 before).
 Aniki. HP reduced.



Thanks for your feedback.
All flex
